items.title: Low solar grazing densities support beneficial insects in agrivoltaic systems
items.title_en: Low solar grazing densities support beneficial insects in agrivoltaic systems
items.title_zh: 较低的太阳能系统植被覆盖密度有助于在农光互补系统中维持益虫种群
items.summary_en: Solar grazing—the co-location of livestock grazing and photovoltaic energy production—is rapidly expanding globally to mitigate land-use conflicts. Solar facilities are increasingly sited on agricultural land, where both sheep grazing and the promotion of agriculturally beneficial insects are recognized as facilitators of multi-functional agroecosystems, yet how stocking rate shapes beneficial insect communities remains poorly understood. We conducted a replicated, three-year experiment testing six stocking rates (0–10 sheep ha−1) at an operational 18 MW solar facility, sampling bees and lady beetles across three years and four grazing rotations per year. Light grazing at 2 sheep ha−1 supported 38% greater beneficial insect abundance than ungrazed controls, driven primarily by an 83% increase in honey bees. High stocking rates (⩾8 sheep ha−1) reduced bee abundance by 42%–68% and significantly changed insect community composition. A companion study identified 8 sheep ha−1 as the agrotechnological optimum, but our results identify 2 sheep ha−1 as the agroecological optimum in our study region, where beneficial insect abundance and flock health are maximized. These optima did not coincide, indicating a clear tradeoff between ecological and operational objectives. However, at 4 sheep ha−1, beneficial insect communities remained statistically indistinguishable from ungrazed controls while vegetation management effectiveness was greater than at 2 sheep ha−1. Together these results define a synergy–tradeoff boundary with direct implications for targeting agroecological outcomes via the operations and maintenance of solar grazing facilities.
items.summary_zh: 太阳能放牧——即牲畜放牧与光伏发电的共址——正在全球范围内迅速扩展，以缓解土地利用冲突。 太阳能设施越来越多地建在农田上，在那里，绵羊放牧和有益农业的昆虫的培育均被公认为多功能农业生态系统的促进因素，但放牧密度如何影响有益昆虫群落，目前仍知之甚少。 我们在一座正在运营的18兆瓦太阳能发电设施中开展了一项为期三年、设有多组重复试验的实验，测试了六种放牧密度（0–10只羊/公顷），并在三年内、每年四个放牧轮作周期中对蜜蜂和瓢虫进行了采样。 每公顷2只羊的轻度放牧，其益虫丰度比未放牧的对照组高出38%，这主要归因于蜜蜂数量增加了83%。高放牧密度（≥8只羊/公顷）使蜜蜂丰度降低了42%–68%，并显著改变了昆虫群落组成。 一项配套研究将8只羊/公顷确定为农业技术上的最优值，但我们的研究结果表明，在研究区域内，2只羊/公顷是农业生态学上的最优值，此时有益昆虫数量和羊群健康状况均达到最大化。这两个最优值并不重合，表明生态目标与运营目标之间存在明显的权衡关系。 然而，在每公顷4只羊的放牧密度下，益虫群落与未放牧对照组的差异在统计学上仍无法区分，而植被管理效果却优于每公顷2只羊的放牧密度。综合来看，这些结果界定了协同效应与权衡之间的边界，对通过太阳能放牧设施的运营和维护来实现农业生态学目标具有直接的指导意义。

items.title: Cyclonic and zonal vertical circulation drive a distinct type of heatwaves over South China
items.title_en: Cyclonic and zonal vertical circulation drive a distinct type of heatwaves over South China
items.title_zh: 气旋式和纬向垂直环流在华南地区引发了一种独特的热浪
items.summary_en: Under global warming, heatwaves over South China (SC) have increased substantially, posing severe threats to socioeconomic systems and human health. Previous studies have primarily emphasized the role of anomalous horizontal anticyclones, while the active dynamical contribution of large-scale vertical circulation remains insufficiently understood. Using the three-pattern decomposition of global atmospheric circulation, we identify two distinct circulation regimes among SC heatwave events during 1979–2022 from a new perspective of three-dimensional circulation dynamics: meridional circulation-dominated type (MC-type) regime and zonal circulation-dominated type (ZC-type) regime. MC-type heatwaves resemble conventional events, with barotropic anticyclonic anomalies and meridional subsidence that are jointly regulated by North Atlantic and tropical Pacific sea surface temperature anomalies. In contrast, ZC-type heatwaves are associated with lower-tropospheric cyclonic circulation and zonal circulation anomalies, with their occurrence favored by central Pacific warming and enhanced tropical cyclone activity over the western North Pacific. Notably, ZC-type heatwaves exhibit pronounced hot-humid characteristics and show a significant increasing trend after 2000. Our study deepens the understanding of the dynamical mechanisms of SC heatwaves and may provide useful insights for future subseasonal prediction of SC heatwaves.
items.summary_zh: 在全球变暖的背景下，华南地区的热浪事件显著增加，对社会经济体系和人类健康构成了严重威胁。以往的研究主要侧重于异常水平反气旋的作用，而大尺度垂直环流的积极动力学贡献仍未得到充分理解。 基于全球大气环流的三模式分解方法，我们从三维环流动力学的新视角出发，识别出1979–2022年间华南热浪事件中的两种截然不同的环流模式： 以子午向环流为主导的类型（MC型）和以经向环流为主导的类型（ZC型）。MC型热浪与传统热浪事件相似，表现为等压反气旋异常和子午向下沉，这两者共同受北大西洋和热带太平洋海表温度异常的调控。 相比之下，ZC型热浪则与对流层下层的气旋性环流及纬向环流异常相关，其中太平洋中部变暖以及西北太平洋热带气旋活动增强是其发生的主要促成因素。 值得注意的是，ZC型热浪表现出明显的湿热特征，且自2000年以来呈现显著的增长趋势。本研究深化了对南半球热浪动力机制的理解，并可能为未来南半球热浪的亚季节预报提供有益的见解。

items.title_en: Scientists uncover the 2.3-billion-year-old secret that helped keep Earth habitable
items.title_zh: 科学家揭开了这个有助于维持地球宜居性的、已有23亿年历史的秘密
items.summary_en: Scientists may have solved a 2.3-billion-year-old mystery about how Earth maintained enough oxygen to support life. Ancient rocks reveal that phosphorus recycling in the oceans created a self-sustaining cycle that helped keep oxygen levels high, even as the planet underwent dramatic environmental changes. The discovery challenges assumptions about Earth's early atmosphere and raises new questions about why complex life took so long to emerge.
items.summary_zh: 科学家们可能已经解开了关于地球如何维持足够氧气以支持生命这一存在了23亿年的谜团。 古代岩石揭示，海洋中的磷循环形成了一个自我维持的循环系统，即使在地球经历剧烈环境变化的时期，该系统也帮助维持了较高的氧气水平。这一发现挑战了关于地球早期大气层的假设，并引发了关于复杂生命为何迟迟未能出现的新疑问。
